description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions is hiring a Software Developer I for its Corporate IT team. The role involves translating business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, building and testing features, and participating in the software development lifecycle and agile process.
Software Developer I contributing to agile software development, translating user stories into code and supporting testing and implementation

Responsibilities:
• Contributes to discussions in meetings with product owners and agile team members to understand business requirements
• Fully participates in the system development life cycle of the company’s software solutions. Is expected to assist with the analysis and design recommendations. Will participate in the coding, testing and implementation efforts
• Responsible for learning and following company standards, policies, and procedures within an agile environment
• Is able to convert user stories into programmable solutions
• Documents and communicates project/task progress with their agile team
• Is expected to complete task in timely manner

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, degree from a Technical school or equivalent work experience
• On the job training is also recognized
• 1-3 years of related experience

Preferred:
• Work experience in Property Casualty or Specialty Insurance a plus!
